problem: Top-12 next-week article recommendation per customer (ranking / implicit-feedback recommender). Positive = customer bought the article in the target week.
unit_of_evaluation: Customers with at least one in-scope purchase in the target week (as in the Kaggle H&M metric). Cold-start customers (no earlier purchase) are included and scored on popularity only.
primary_metric: MAP@12 (Kaggle H&M definition: AP@12 divided by min(|actual|, 12), averaged over evaluated customers)
secondary_metrics: candidate recall (share of target-week purchases present in the candidate set)
MAP@12 by activity tier and by age band (test only)

split.type: time-based, by purchase date (same column 'split' as data-v1.0)

learned_ranker_training_weeks.for_validation: 4 target weeks ending 2020-09-08 (starts 2020-08-12, 08-19, 08-26, 09-02); features for each week use only transactions dated before that week
learned_ranker_training_weeks.for_test: same 4-week scheme shifted one week later (starts 2020-08-19 .. 2020-09-09), so the validation week becomes the most recent training week; hyper-parameters stay frozen at the validation choice

leakage_guards: Every feature for a target week starting on day S is computed from rows with t_dat < S only

No customer-level field from customers_clean that was derived from the train window is used for the test week (units_train, visits_train etc. are recomputed per week from history instead); only age is taken from customers_clean
basket_units (flagged leakage-risk in the D2 dictionary) is not used
Test set is scored once per model by run_experiments.py --stage test, which writes outputs/test_lock.json and refuses a second run unless --force is given (any forced rerun is logged as such)

tuning_budget.M1 item-to-item co-purchase scorer: full grid of 3 x 3 x 3 = 27 settings on validation
tuning_budget.M3 LightGBM LambdaRank: random search, 12 trials, sampler seed 42; best trial re-run with model seeds 1, 2, 3 to show seed variance

selection_rule: Highest validation MAP@12 per model family; ties broken by the simpler setting. The overall choice is made on validation only.
